title: Comfort Care Tune-Up Scope of Service by Agreement Level
content:
Services the HVAC Maintenance Agreements switch on at each agreement level for a completed tune-up visit. "Yes" means the level includes the service; "No" means it does not.

| Service | Essential | Standard | Plus | Dual-System | Dual-System Plus | Premier |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Standard 1-inch filters replaced at each visit | No | No | Yes | No | Yes | Yes |
| Number of standard filters replaced per visit | 0 | 0 | 1 | 0 | 1 | 2 |
| Condensate drain flushed and treated | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Refrigerant top-off included per term per system, pounds | 0 | 0 | 1 | 0 | 1 | 2 |
| Outdoor coil cleaning | No | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Carbon monoxide test performed on the heating visit | No | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Thermostat checked and calibrated | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Annual water heater flush | No | No | No | No | No | Yes |
| Indoor air quality check | No | No | No | No | Yes | Yes |
| One UV air purifier lamp replacement per term | No | No | No | No | No | Yes |

Column headings are the levels Bridgewell Comfort Care Essential, Bridgewell Comfort Care Standard, Bridgewell Comfort Care Plus, Bridgewell Comfort Care Dual-System, Bridgewell Comfort Care Dual-System Plus and Bridgewell Comfort Care Premier.

## Notes on the schedule

- Filter replacement is included on Plus and Dual-System Plus with one standard filter per visit, and on Premier with two standard filters per visit; Essential, Standard and Dual-System include no filter replacement and list zero filters per visit.
- The refrigerant top-off allowance is counted per system per term, not per visit: one pound on Plus and Dual-System Plus, two pounds on Premier, and none on Essential, Standard and Dual-System.
- The condensate drain service and the thermostat check and calibration are included on all six levels.
- Coil cleaning and the carbon monoxide test are included on every level except Essential.
- The indoor air quality check is included on Dual-System Plus and Premier; the water heater flush and the UV lamp replacement are included on Premier only.

## Scope questions

**Does a Bridgewell Comfort Care Premier system receive four pounds of refrigerant across two visits in a term?** No. Premier includes two pounds of refrigerant top-off per system per term in total, whatever the number of visits.

**Is a carbon monoxide test part of the Bridgewell Comfort Care Standard tune-up?** It is included on Standard and is performed on the heating visit.
